rule: A GM in catch-up holds a state request it cannot answer until the catch-up ends.
Held requests are not answered when an answer to that nonce was seen before the catch-up exit.
A catching-up client asks again with the same nonce when a GM comes online before an answer arrives.
A late complete answer to the last own nonce does not start a GM-return catch-up.
A GM client does not enter a GM-return catch-up.
The catch-up timeout does not end catch-up while a generation is being adopted.
While adopting a generation, answers of another generation do not count.
Differing alive messages from one burst count only once.
An answered exit ignores the drift starter as well as the responder.
A GM in a drift catch-up can answer state requests.
A GM in catch-up does not answer pings.
